question: For contribution to which dance was Tanjore Balasaraswati awarded the title of Sangita Kalanidhi by Madras Music Academy in 1973?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Bharatanatyam** is a classical dance style that originated in **Tamil Nadu's** South Indian state, making this dance style well known in various parts of India and many parts of the world.
 
• In **1973** she was awarded the title of **Sangita Kalanidhi **by **Madras Music Academy**.
 
• In **1957** she was awarded the** Padma Bhushan** and in **1977** the **Padma Vibhushan**.
 
• She received the **Sangeetha Kalasikhamani Award** from The Indian Fine Arts Society, Chennai, in **1981**.
 
• She was the only non-Western dancer included in a Dance Heritage Coalition compilation, "The Irreplaceable Treasures of Dance" in America.
 
• **Satyajit Ray**, a Bengali film director, made a documentary film on Balasaraswati called **Bala (1976).**
